conception.note: The tool was conceived by the author for their own live-performance practice — a browser VJ instrument to run alongside a DAW; the model sharpened scope and proposed features within that brief.

structure.note: The two-window BroadcastChannel architecture and the shader compositor/feedback/source module layout were model-proposed and landed whole in the initial commit; the author set the functional requirements they had to satisfy.

production.note: All engine code, shaders, UI, and docs were model-generated to the author's spec across 45 of 48 commits, reviewed and redirected commit by commit rather than accepted wholesale.

curation.note: The model performed the revision, restructure, and cleanup passes; the author set the criteria and made every keep/cut/redirect call (e.g. trimming the intro, choosing fix approach B, stripping em dashes from the Spanish guide).

verification.note: The model ran the programmatic checks (dev-server console, BroadcastChannel message sampling, hue-sweep timing); the author found bugs through real-world use and performs the two-window/fullscreen testing the sandbox cannot, and signs off.
